Book correction: The book prints the middle step as \frac{1 \pm \sqrt{3}i}{2}; the minus sign of -1 is missing. Correctly: x = \frac{-1 \pm \sqrt{1-4}}{2} = \frac{-1 \pm \sqrt{-3}}{2} = \frac{-1 \pm \sqrt{3}\,i}{2}, as the book's next line shows.
